name: Day-night cycle and time advancement
note: The world's day time advances after each tick's commands while doDaylightCycle is on, persists and goes through Anvil import and export; /time sets and queries it with the official parser and replies; set_time goes to players on joining, every 20 ticks and on changes, as on both official servers
deviations: sleeping and the other behavior that depends on the time of day, except daylight detectors, is not modeled
